newsitem.title: FRANCE: SBC-Warburg ups Total EPS, share targets.
newsitem.headline: SBC-Warburg ups Total EPS, share targets.

text.p: SBC-Warburg has raised its forecast for Total SA earnings per share by 14 percent for 1997 and has increased its target for the share price by 20 percent to 635 francs, market sources said on Wednesday.
The brokeage firm, reaffirming its buy position on the stock, now sees earnings per share of 29.80 francs for 1997, 35.50 francs for 1998 et 44.90 francs for 1999, they said.
Goldman Sachs on Tuesday raised its recommendation on the stock to "market outperformer" from "market performer".
"When big (finance) houses like that lift their forecasts at the same time, it means they know something," one fund manager said.

Warburg had confirmed its "buy" recommendation and said its results forecast upgrade was based on production expectations, noting the group's was banking on a "very big" well in Angola allowing it exceed a goal of a million barrels a day by the year 2000, the sources said.
The Total share stood 0.90 percent up at 558 francs at 1337 GMT after touching a day high of 567 francs. The CAC-40 leading share index was up 1.21 percent at the same time.
